name: Authentication
question: Which auth provider do coding agents pick?
headline: Auth is the category where agents are most likely to hand-roll a JWT and call it done.
description: Measures whether an agent reaches for a hosted identity provider, an open-source auth library, or writes its own session and password handling.

prompts.text: Add sign up and sign in to this app. Users should be able to create an account, log in, log out, and hit a route that only works when they are logged in.
I need authentication and sessions here. Protect the dashboard route so anonymous visitors are redirected, and keep the user signed in across reloads.
Set up user accounts for this project, including login, logout, and a way to read the current user on the server.
